method_summary: Improved from 0.461 to 0.4385 relative CPU time. Core optimizations: reshaped matmul replaces einsum for q/k/v projections; output computed as p_mix@v instead of (p_mix@x)@wv^T, which trades B*H*L^2*D + B*L*C*H*D for B*H*L^2*C + B*H*L*C*D — much cheaper when D<<C; norms computed via Gram matrix G=xx^T with (pG*p).sum(-1) instead of direct p@x + norm, saving B*H*L^2*C vs B*H*L^3 when C>L; direct 4D softmax replaces view+2D+view pattern; aggressive in-place elementwise ops (mul_, add_, sqrt_, clamp_, div_) cut allocations. All quality gates pass.
